notes.title: V1.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there, players!

Thank you so much for your support and valuable feedback. We're working hard to improve the game and address your concerns. Here's what's new in the V1.1.2 update:

[b]New Features[/b]
- Added shortcut keys. WASD and ↑↓←→ can be used to move the screen.
- Added an "Exit Game" button in the settings interface.
- Display chat barrage in the Easter egg gameplay.
- Added in-game acquisition judgment after purchasing DLC.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Optimized the occasional situation where a blank area is clicked by other players, but the information is not synchronized and displayed.
- Adjusted the color of the text for flag-drawing consumption points in the German skin panel.

As a small indie team, we're constantly striving to enhance your gaming experience and address issues promptly. Your feedback is crucial to us, but please bear with us as we might not be able to respond to every issue immediately due to limited resources. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

We're also planning future updates, and we'd love to hear your ideas! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Q4nzsCN7Qt]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts. If you encounter any problems while playing, please join our community to communicate with us. This helps us understand and resolve issues more quickly.

Thanks again for your support and understanding!
Happy gaming!

notes.title: One week the game's release, thank you for the support!
notes.notes:
Hey there, players!

Since the release of “Let’s Minesweeper” we have received feedback and suggestions from players. We deeply appreciate every player’s enthusiastic support and valuable opinions.

As a small indie game team, we are continually striving to improve the gaming experience and address your issues promptly. Your feedback is crucial to us, but due to our limited manpower, we may not be able to respond to and resolve every issue immediately. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding.

To communicate more efficiently, we sincerely invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Q4nzsCN7Qt]Discord[/url] . Here, you can interact with us, share your feedback and suggestions, and we will be able to understand and address your issues more quickly and directly. This will also help us build a closer connection with our players.

We are also planning the content for future versions of the game. If you have any suggestions or ideas, please join our[url=https://discord.gg/Q4nzsCN7Qt] Discord [/url]and share them with us!

Thank you once again for your understanding and support! We look forward to meeting you in the game and creating a better gaming experience together.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo Version Closure Notice: Full Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032094/283611739420c593da9dfd88b5adc63011a29f88.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Thank you for your support and love for Let's Minesweeper! Today, we are excited to share some great news with you –[b] the full version of Let's Minesweeper will be officially released on July 24rd at 7:00 AM (UTC+0)[/b]

To prepare for this launch,  [b]we will be closing the demo version ofLet's Minesweeper on July 23rd at 2:00 AM (UTC+0)[/b]. We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who participated in the demo. Your support and feedback have been invaluable in helping us improve the game and deliver a better experience.

We hope you will continue to enjoy and support our game in the days to come. Once again, thank you to all the players for your playtesting and anticipation! Let’s welcome the official release of Let's Minesweeperand embark on a new chapter of minesweeping fun!

Happy gaming！

notes.title: 💣Let's Minesweeper Release Date Announced!💣
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
 
We're thrilled to share some exciting news with you all—Let's Minesweeper will officially launch on July 24th!
 
During the demo period, we received tons of positive feedback and suggestions from players. Thank you so much for your love and support! We're committed to bringing you the pure joy of minesweeping.
 
While you're at it, don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist. We also invite you to join our official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Q4nzsCN7Qt, where you can share the minesweeping fun with other players!

notes.title: Bug Fixes Maintenance
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Thanks for everyone experiencing the Let's Minesweeper Demo. Because of the existing bug of Steam user name causing problems to player score, we've decided to close the server from 10 am to 11 am on Monday, June 24th. We are terribly sorry for all inconvenience caused. 

Do not forget to add Let's Minesweeper to your Steam Wishlist. Your help means the world for us, and we are really grateful for all your kind support. We also welcome you to join our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/VcdYb2dj. Come and sweep your mines with all your minepals!
